info.name: Account Account API Ranking History API API

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain to analyze ranking history for.

params.name: queryType
params.description: Type of ranking analysis to perform.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Beginning date for range

params.name: endDate
params.description: Ending date for range

params.name: includeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms that must be present in the keyword.

params.name: includeAnyTerm
params.description: Used with includeTerms. If true: match any term (OR). If false: require all terms (AND).

params.name: excludeTerms
params.description: Comma-separated list of terms to exclude from results (e.g., branded or irrelevant terms).

params.name: startRank.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL starting rank position is ≥ this value for the selected date range (1 = best/top organic result).

params.name: startRank.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL starting rank position is ≤ this value for the selected date range (1 = best/top organic result).

params.name: endRank.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL ending rank position is ≥ this value for the selected date range (1 = best/top organic result).

params.name: endRank.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the domain/URL ending rank position is ≤ this value for the selected date range (1 = best/top organic result).

params.name: endRankChange.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the rank improved by at least this many positions between the start and end of the date range (end_rank_change ≥ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

params.name: endRankChange.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the rank change was at most this many positions between the start and end of the date range (end_rank_change ≤ value). Positive values mean moved up; negative values mean moved down.

params.name: seoClicks.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where estimated monthly organic clicks (SEO clicks) to the domain/url are ≥ this value.

params.name: seoClicks.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where estimated monthly organic clicks (SEO clicks) to the domain/url are ≤ this value.

params.name: seoClicksChange.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month change in estimated organic clicks is ≥ this value. Positive values indicate click gains; negative values indicate click losses.

params.name: seoClicksChange.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where the month-over-month change in estimated organic clicks is ≤ this value. Positive values indicate click gains; negative values indicate click losses.

params.name: searchVolume.min
params.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≥ this value.

params.name: searchVolume.max
params.description: Filter to keywords where monthly search volume (Google) is ≤ this value.

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Country market to search. Specifically, this maps to the Google domain version to query against (e.g., google.com for US, google.de for Germany, etc.). All Countries

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field to sort by

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of rows returned.

params.name: startingRow
params.description: Row number to start the results with.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Order to sort by

items.docs:
Returns historical organic ranking data for a domain across multiple keywords within a specified date range. Track position changes, click gains/losses, and ranking trends over time to analyze SEO performance.

[Visualize this API live on SpyFu](https://www.spyfu.com/seo/ranking-history/domain?expandChart=false&searchType=MostValuable&includeAnyTerm=true&query=example.com&sidebarContext=topics) _(TODO – verify)_
